verdicts.claim: Spec note misquotes Ferrari: the page says "270 hp", never "bhp"
verdicts.evidence: Ferrari's page https://www.ferrari.com/en-EN/auto/328-gts, fetched 18 Sep 2026 via curl with a browser User-Agent (HTTP 200, 488 KB - it does not 403), contains in its "chassis and engine" body prose: "but was fitted with a Marelli MED 806 A electronic ignition system, to produce a claimed power output of 270bhp at 7000rpm." The same HTML's tech-specs list carries "Maximum power 199 kW (270 hp) at 7000 rpm" (rendered server-side, no in-browser read needed). So Ferrari's page uses BOTH "270bhp" and "270 hp"; the site's note "Ferrari's page gives the output as 270 bhp, but that is the metric figure (270 cv)" quotes the prose faithfully, and the finding's premise ("the body never writes 'bhp'") is false. The conversion stands as the finding concedes: 270 cv x 0.9863 = 266.3 hp; 199 kW / 0.7457 = 266.9 hp.
